text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Outta my waaaay! Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaah... Hyaaaah! As if I'm gonna give
up now!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (How are those two still going?!)

text_block_list.name: Inari & Bamboo
text_block_list.text: Come on, come on, come ooooon! Pant, pant... Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Nnng... Gyaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
That's it, Inari One! Break through, just
like that!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Go, Yaeno Muteki! Stay on her!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Don't give up, Bamboo! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One charges forward as if she's
been
possessed, while Bamboo Memory
desperately
wills her body to keep
moving.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clear their fighting spirits are what's
pushing
them forward.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... I did it... I did it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heheh! Ya certainly got guts!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Course I do! I wanted to win!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, Yaeno! What was that out there?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You were holding back, weren't you? I
bet you
coulda gone harder!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ha! I'm right, aren't I? You know that
neither of us
can be happy with these
results, right?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'll be at the autumn Tenno Sho next! If
you wanna
make things right, you better
be there!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'll be there too! After all, I heard
Oguri's planning
on running!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But if you're gonna come, you better
show us
what you actually got!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Inari thinks I'm holding back...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But I burned up every last drop of my
obsession! I
ran with everything I had!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Even Bamboo said I wasn't giving it my
all
before...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Am I missing something? Am I actually
holding
myself back without realizing it?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: What do you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Is there something different between
how I run
and how Inari and Bamboo
run?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that I could feel their spirits
forcing their
bodies forward. They were
laying bare their
burning will to win, and
that gave them a secret
source of power
to push them past their limits.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I see.. they laid bare their wills...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
So Inari and Bamboo burn up all their
energy,
which allows them to surpass
their limits.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And I...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: You too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki runs without fully
unleashing her
fierce blaze. Instead, she
uses water still to
temper and control it,
all to prevent herself from
running wild.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that it's possible she could
surpass her
current limits if she were to
put the full force of
her passion into her
running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That said, I don't know whether or not
she can
control that passion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that, before we even try it, we
have to
figure out if she's able to
unleash those emotions
and let them
come to the surface.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's why, even when she tries to let
her
emotions out, an unconscious part of
her keeps
them locked away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ultimately, she's afraid her running will
fall apart
entirely if she does.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Abandoning her teachings and running
with her
fighting spirit completely
unleashed brings with it
a considerable
risk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the same, I let her know that if she
wants to
search for a way to unlock the
full fury of her
emotions, I intend to do
everything in my power
to help her.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I understand...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but I'd like some time to think
it over.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. This is not a decision to be
made
lightly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki and I leave the racecourse
and
walk back to the station.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if a switch has flipped inside her, she
raises her
head and walks straight ahead,
eyes forward.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I would like to race in the autumn Tenno
Sho
next.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho is held at Tokyo

Racecourse, which I think is quite
well-suited for
Yaeno Muteki. The
distance is right up her alley
as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oguri's going to be there.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Her popularity is skyrocketing even as
we speak.
Heavens know how much
stronger she's getting...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap uses the support of her fans
as a
source of fuel in her races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
People of all ages are being swept up in
Oguri
fever, enchanted by her incredible
ability.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Be that as it may, I will do what I must.
Right or
wrong, that's what I believe is
best.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I hit a wall, I won't stop to worry about
it. I'll
continue running and feel it in the
moment.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Then our training for the autumn
Tenno
Sho starts tomorrow. I'm counting
on you.
